title: Filipino Benchmarks for Measuring Sexist and Homophobic Bias in Multilingual Language Models from Southeast Asia

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the pseudo-log-likelihood of minimally differentiated sentence pairs to evaluate if models assign higher probabilities to gender-stereotypical statements using the culturally adapted Filipino CrowS-Pairs benchmark.

Comparing the pseudo-log-likelihood of minimally differentiated sentence pairs to evaluate if models assign higher probabilities to homophobic and anti-queer statements using the culturally adapted Filipino WinoQueer and CrowS-Pairs benchmarks.
